## C5 fix F2: split each span bottom resistor into two in parallel (S16 bands re-checked)

- **span UV**: S16 option 2 (240000.0, 6200.0) -> trip [15.6821, 16.0872], release [15.8007, 16.4862], Q catch +0.182 / rail +0.089 V.
  F2 pick: top 193000 ohm (new line), bottom 2 x 10000 ohm RT0603BRD0710KL (JLC stock 2125333) -> trip [15.64, 16.0416], release [15.7582, 16.4395], Q catch +0.140 / rail +0.136 V.
  One half open: pin 0.8584 V; span UV now trips only below ~8.1 V: partial mask, no overstress.
- **span OV**: S16 option 2 (86600.0, 2000.0) -> trip [17.4992, 17.9425], release [17.0584, 17.809], Q catch +1.058 / rail +0.074 V.
  F2 pick: top 138000 ohm (new line), bottom 2 x 6200 ohm RT0603BRD076K2L (JLC stock 90071) -> trip [17.9783, 18.4364], release [17.5254, 18.2992], Q catch +0.564 / rail +0.553 V (span OV judged on 19.0 V; against S16's 18.0 V basis the catch is -0.436 V).
